note: SND-13's import settings (not tuning). Loudness targets per band in LUFS (Proposed: whisper -38, talk -26, shout -16; the scream -10), each kept under SND-07's band cap: the 20 ms frame RMS ceiling of the next band's default threshold plus voice.band_cap_headroom_db (whisper -34, talk -16, shout -6 dBFS), and -1 dBFS for the scream (Proposed). The lampman is dry Ogg Vorbis at -20 LUFS (Proposed). Placeholder voices are espeak-ng (offline text-to-speech): eight distinct voices from accent, variant, pitch and speed.

spoken.tapping: Tapping! Shut up, and get off the walls!
spoken.stythe: Stythe! Light up, and talk to me!
spoken.first_run: One lamp's worth a dozen men below. Keep it low by the coats, and keep talking.
spoken.remark_moth_smother: Somebody's lamp drew it down on them. Keep them low.
spoken.remark_drag: Nobody walks at the back alone.
spoken.remark_pin: Off the walls when it taps.
spoken.remark_blast: Naked flame where the gas lies. Gauze lamps, lads.
spoken.remark_blackdamp: Watch your flame. When it shrinks, you get out.
spoken.remark_shot_dead: A gun below does more harm than good.
